successCriteria.description: `src/shared/error-types.ts` exports `NotFoundError`, `ValidationError`, and `ConflictError` classes, each extending native `Error`, with `name` set to the class name, `message` from constructor, and an optional `details: unknown` property (undefined when not provided).

`src/shared/base-repository.ts` exports a generic abstract class `BaseRepository<T>` whose constructor accepts a `Pool` (from `pg`), stores it as a protected field, exposes a protected `query(text: string, params?: unknown[]): Promise<QueryResult>` method that delegates to `pool.query`, and declares an abstract `findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>` method.

`tests/unit/shared/error-types.test.ts` passes: verifies each error class is an instance of both `Error` and its own class, has correct `name` and `message`, supports optional `details`, and has `undefined` details when omitted.

`tests/unit/shared/base-repository.test.ts` passes: verifies constructor stores pool, `query` delegates to `pool.query` with correct arguments and returns its result, `query` propagates pool errors, and `findById` returns entity when found or null when not found.

constraints: The `details` property on all error classes must be typed as `unknown`, not `any` (per HARNESS.json `no-any` constraint).
outOfScope: Actual leave domain repositories (LeavePolicyRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository) that will extend BaseRepository — these are Phases 3-5.
Any database migration or table creation — this phase only provides the abstract base class and error types.
